title: feat(payments): Migrate stripe-v2 to stripe-v3 contract with strict idempotency key
author: sarah.chen@aegis.internal
diffSummary: Removes deprecated /v1/charge endpoint in favor of /v2/payment_intents. Requires non-null idempotency_key header in all inbound requests.
apiDiffPayload:
BREAKING: Removed endpoint POST /v1/charge
ADDED: Required header 'X-Idempotency-Key' in POST /v2/payment_intents
CHANGED: Field 'amount' type from float to integer (cents)

title: refactor(notifications): Optimize dead-letter queue retry exponential backoff
author: alex.kumar@aegis.internal
diffSummary: Internal worker refactoring. Implements jittered exponential backoff for failed SMS/Email deliveries without modifying public interfaces.
apiDiffPayload: NO BREAKING CHANGES. Internal message consumption retry policy update.

title: feat(orders): Call analytics synchronously for fraud validation hook
author: marcus.vance@aegis.internal
diffSummary: Introduces direct synchronous gRPC call from OrderService to AnalyticsWorker before order commit, which creates a circular dependency through Kafka.
apiDiffPayload: WARNING: Potential circular dependency detected in call chain (Order -> Analytics -> Kafka -> Order).
